entities.name: František Radkovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Radkovský is a Czech Roman Catholic prelate, who served as the first Bishop of Plzeň from 1993 to 2016. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Prague and titular bishop of Aggar from 1990 to 1993.
